title: Royal 24K Honey Velvet Matte Lipstick
subtitle: Velvet Matte Finish with Propolis Nectar Infusion
short_description: Infused with pure honey propolis and raw royal jelly for all-day comfort.
description: Rich velvety luxury lipstick designed specifically for warm South Asian skin tones. Glides on smoothly with high-pigment payoff.
how_to_use: Swipe directly onto lips from center outwards for a bold finish.
ingredients: Dimethicone, Propolis Extract, Royal Jelly, Beeswax, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Iron Oxides.
shades: Velvet Plum|#6A1B6D|01|berry; Crimson Honey|#9E2A2B|02|red; Warm Nectar|#D4AF37|03|nude

title: Propolis Barrier Glow Rescue Serum
subtitle: Concentrated 73% Raw Honey & Ceramide Barrier Defense
short_description: Clinically proven barrier recovery serum formulated for humid tropical climates.
description: Intense moisture barrier serum with raw propolis, niacinamide, and 5-ceramide complex to soothe irritated and stressed skin.
how_to_use: Dispense 3-4 drops onto cleansed face and gently pat until absorbed. Use AM and PM.
ingredients: Propolis Extract (73%), Niacinamide (2%), Centella Asiatica, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ceramide NP.

title: Silk Petal Cushion Blush & Lip Tint
subtitle: Multi-Use Soft Matte Velvet Blush for Cheeks and Lips
short_description: Featherlight cream-to-powder blush infused with botanical rosewater.
description: Multi-tasking velvet blush and lip tint that melts seamlessly into South Asian skin tones without clinging to texture.
how_to_use: Dab onto apples of cheeks and blend upwards with fingertips or beauty sponge.
ingredients: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Mica, Silica, Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Tocopherol.
